topic: Cross-cutting plugin systemic issues — markdown stripping, mode inference, completion markers
insight: 7 bugs fixed across protocol-gate and delegation-gate. Key fix patterns: (1) Strip `**` from regex-captured values when agents write markdown-formatted structured data; (2) When structured fields are missing, scan text for known keywords with word-boundary regex; (3) Replace implicit signals (git status) with explicit completion markers (sentinel files); (4) Track dispatch counts to gate parallel work phase advancement.
